Module de.learnlib.testsupport.it
Package de.learnlib.testsupport.it.util

Class LearnerITUtil

java.lang.Object
de.learnlib.testsupport.it.util.LearnerITUtil
public final class LearnerITUtil extends Object
Utility class for integration tests for a learning algorithm (or "learner").

A learner integration test tests the functionality of a learning algorithm against a well-defined set of example setups.

    • createExampleITCases

      public static <I, D, A extends UniversalDeterministicAutomaton.RegularAutomaton<?, I, ?, ?, ?> & Output<I, D>> List<UniversalDeterministicLearnerITCase<I,D,A>> createExampleITCases(LearningExample.UniversalDeterministicLearningExample<I,? extends A> example, LearnerVariantListImpl<A,I,D> variants, LockableOracle<I,D> lockableOracle, EquivalenceOracle<? super A,I,D> eqOracle)
      Creates a list of per-example test cases for all learner variants.
      Type Parameters:
      I - input symbol type
      D - output domain type
      A - automaton type
      Parameters:
      example - the example system
      variants - the list containing the various learner variants
      lockableOracle - the lockable oracle to check stable hypothesis construction
      eqOracle - the equivalence oracle to use by the learning process
      Returns:
      the list of test cases, one for each example
